title: Senior Engineer - Electrical - Pipavav Gujarat
description:
Company: Swan Defence & Heavy Industries Limited (SDHI)
 Location: Pipavav, Gujarat
 Department: Design & Engineering Electrical Design
 Experience:4-10 Years
 Qualification: Diploma / Certification in Electrical Engineering or CAD Design, B.Tech 
 Industry Preference: Shipbuilding, Marine, Ship Repair, Heavy Engineering 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Draughtsman, Designer, Electrical, Engineer , Senior Engineer , Assistant Manager , Deputy Manager to join our Design & Engineering team at Pipavav, Gujarat. The candidate will be responsible for preparing detailed electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and layouts for shipbuilding and ship repair projects. The role requires proficiency in CAD software, strong technical drafting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate with electrical engineers, designers, production, and quality teams. 
 Key Responsibilities Prepare detailed electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and layouts based on engineering designs. Develop electrical layouts for power distribution, lighting, control systems, and auxiliary systems. Use AutoCAD Electrical or other relevant CAD tools to create and modify technical drawings. Update drawings based on engineering revisions, project requirements, and feedback from the design team. Ensure drawings comply with project specifications, applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and client requirements. Conduct drawing quality checks to ensure accuracy, clarity, and completeness. Maintain proper documentation and revision control of electrical drawings. Coordinate with production teams to support the installation, assembly, and testing of electrical systems. Work closely with electrical engineers, designers, and quality assurance teams to resolve drawing-related issues. Support technical reviews, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities as required. 
 Required Skills Proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical or similar CAD drafting software. Knowledge of electrical schematics, circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, and electrical layouts. Understanding of power distribution, lighting, control systems, and auxiliary electrical systems. Basic knowledge of IEC, IEEE, and relevant electrical design standards. Strong attention to detail and drawing accuracy. Ability to interpret engineering specifications and incorporate design modifications. Good coordination and communication skills. 
 Educational Qualification Diploma or certification in Electrical Engineering, CAD Design, or a related discipline , B.Tech. 
 Experience 4 to 10 + years of experience in electrical drafting, preferably in the shipbuilding, marine, ship repair, or heavy engineering industry. 
 About Swan Group Swan Group is a 115+ year-old engineering and project-oriented conglomerate with business interests in textiles, real estate, oil & gas, petroleum products, shipbuilding, and heavy engineering. Swan Defence & Heavy Industries Limited operates the Pipavav shipyard in Gujarat, a strategic marine infrastructure asset with a vision to become a national champion shipyard. Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.

Key Skills: Electrical Design,Control Panel Design,Panel Designing,Senior,Control panel,Panels,Electricals,Control
